verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. `is_absolute_iri` now validates the RFC 3987 component structure relevant to the reported acceptance gap: authority/userinfo/host/port boundaries, IPv6 and IPvFuture literals, IPv4 tails, percent escapes, query/fragment placement, and component-specific Unicode classes. The previously cited witnesses (`http://[` and a non-numeric port) are rejected both by focused predicate tests and through the real datatype-expansion path, while representative valid authority and authority-less IRIs are protected against over-rejection. The bracket exception outside authority is explicitly bounded, justified by a pinned positive W3C case, and tested. The negative conformance runners compare exact error codes and include non-vacuity/scope-pin tests. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect remains in the diff-scoped change.
